name: carousel-host.scss
html:
// ── Custom Carousel Shadow DOM host styles ────────────────────────────────────
// Applied INSIDE the <custom-carousel> Shadow Root.
// These supplement carousel.scss (general carousel styles) and internals.scss
// (slide item styles). Rules here override or complement those where Shadow DOM
// isolation requires explicit redeclaration inside the shadow root.

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';

/// BEM block fragments — composed via interpolation so prefix strings
/// are declared once (DRY selector rule 9).
$_B_CAROUSEL: 'carousel';
$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE: '#{$_B_CAROUSEL}-slide';
$_B_INTERNAL_EXTRA: 'internal-extra-item';

// ── Shadow host ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
:host {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

// ── Ratio modifiers for landscape carousels on mobile ─────────────────────────
.#{$_B_CAROUSEL} {
  &--ratio-16-9 {
    --carousel-media-height: calc((90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}) * 9 / 16);
  }

  &--ratio-21-9 {
    --carousel-media-height: calc((90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}) * 9 / 21);
  }

  &--ratio-32-9 {
    --carousel-media-height: calc((90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}) * 9 / 32);
  }

  &--mixed {
    .#{$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE} {
      height: var(--carousel-media-height);
      overflow: hidden;
      contain: paint;
      clip-path: inset(0);
    }

    .#{$_B_INTERNAL_EXTRA} {
      height: var(--carousel-media-height);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      contain: paint;
      clip-path: inset(0);
    }

    @include layout-768() {
      .#{$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE} {
        height: auto;
        overflow: visible;
        contain: none;
        clip-path: none;
      }

      .#{$_B_INTERNAL_EXTRA} {
        height: auto;
        min-height: 100%;
        overflow: visible;
        contain: none;
        clip-path: none;
      }
    }
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    &--ratio-16-9,
    &--ratio-21-9,
    &--ratio-32-9 {
      --carousel-media-height: initial;
    }
  }
}

// ── Slide wrapper — must not clip content ────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE} {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  scroll-snap-align: center;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: visible;
}

// ── Slide item container ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// These styles mirror .internal-extra-item from internals.scss but must be
// redeclared here because Shadow DOM isolation prevents the parent's stylesheet
// from styling elements inside <custom-carousel>'s Shadow Root.
.#{$_B_INTERNAL_EXTRA} {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: inline-block;
  width: min-content;
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
  box-sizing: border-box;

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    // Desktop: keep ≥24px of margin on each side of every slide item — the
    // media box inside can never sit closer to its neighbours than
    // padding + 24px, which keeps the "click to open" affordance and the
    // corner borders clear of adjacent slides.
    margin-inline: to-rem(24);
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  // In the carousel context, every item is the sole child of its slide,
  // so :first-of-type/:last-of-type both match — they'd zero-out padding.
  // Restore symmetric gaps between items in the carousel track.
  .#{$_B_CAROUSEL} & {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-768() {
      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
    }
    @include layout-1920() {
      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-3xl);
      }
      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: to-rem($space-3xl);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Mixed landscape compensation pattern (mobile) ─────────────────────────
  &.#{$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE}--mixed-landscape {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    width: var(--carousel-landscape-media-width, calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}));
    max-width: calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)});
    overflow: hidden;
    contain: paint;
    clip-path: inset(0);

    .#{$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE}-pattern {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: to-rem($space-lg);
      right: to-rem($space-lg);
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      contain: paint;
      clip-path: inset(0);

      &--top,
      &--bottom {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        height: 50%;
        object-fit: cover;
        filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
        opacity: 0.6;
        contain: paint;
      }

      &--top {
        transform: scaleY(-1);
      }

      &--bottom {
        transform: scaleY(-1);
      }
    }

    media-figure {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)});
      --mf-h: var(
        --carousel-landscape-media-height,
        var(--carousel-media-height, calc((90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}) * 9 / 16))
      );
    }

    @include layout-768() {
      width: min-content;
      max-width: none;
      overflow: visible;
      contain: none;
      clip-path: none;

      .#{$_B_CAROUSEL_SLIDE}-pattern {
        display: none;
      }

      media-figure {
        --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
      }
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      media-figure {
        --mf-h: var(--space-7xl);
      }
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      media-figure {
        --mf-h: var(--space-8xl);
      }
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      media-figure {
        --mf-h: var(--space-9xl);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── CSS Custom Properties for media-figure Shadow DOM sizing ────────────────
  // internals.scss sets these on <media-figure> in the light DOM, but when
  // <media-figure> is inside <custom-carousel>'s Shadow Root, the light DOM
  // rules can't reach it. We must redeclare the same vars here, inside the
  // carousel Shadow Root, where they can reach nested <media-figure> elements.
  media-figure {
    --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)});
    --mf-h: var(--carousel-media-height, calc(70vh - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}));
    --mf-h: var(--carousel-media-height, calc(70dvh - #{calc(var(--space-xl) * 2)}));

    @include layout-768() {
      --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
      --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
      --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{calc(var(--space-2xl) * 2)});
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      --mf-w: var(--space-6xl);
      --mf-h: var(--space-7xl);
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      --mf-w: var(--space-7xl);
      --mf-h: var(--space-8xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      --mf-w: var(--space-8xl);
      --mf-h: var(--space-9xl);
    }
  }

  // landscape variant: --mf-w carries the vw cap (consumed as the
  // placeholder's max-width) so wide media uses most of the viewport;
  // --mf-max-w mirrors it for any max-width consumer.
  &.landscape media-figure {
    @include layout-1024() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-3xl));
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-3xl));
    }

    @include layout-1280() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-4xl));
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-4xl));
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-7xl));
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-7xl));
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-6xl));
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - var(--space-6xl));
    }
  }

  // small variant
  &.small media-figure {
    @include layout-1440() {
      --mf-w: var(--space-6xl);
      --mf-h: var(--space-8xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      --mf-w: var(--space-7xl);
      --mf-h: var(--space-9xl);
    }
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
